availability_evidence: Annual report pages 20 and 45 state that the strategic report and financial statements were approved by the Board on 10 November 2021; issuer-hosted report bytes are hash-preserved locally.
observation: Revenue declined 2% to £31.0m as COVID-19 curtailed outpatient procedures. Adjusted EBITDA fell 14% to £8.4m, adjusted profit before tax fell 35% to £4.6m and adjusted pre-tax margin contracted to 17% from 22%. Even so, operating cash flow was £6.7m, cash rose to £8.1m and the Group had no external debt. Management announced discontinuation of lower-margin non-core products and investment to remedy quality-system weaknesses.
already_announced_exclusion: The announced discontinuation of non-core products, quality-system remediation, recruitment and investment programmes disclosed before cutoff are excluded from any future target event.
review_note: Revenue, profit and margin contraction plus explicit disappointment and remediation language create material pressure. Strong cash generation, rising cash and no external debt provide meaningful contrary evidence and limit cash pressure.
